subject: Simple class condition
notes: kb/Work PB571. SR4 names THREE categories and only the BOOLEAN one was screened, so `IF <numeric item> IS ALPHABETIC` compiled and ran. All three are now one predicate. SR4 names class-name-1 and NOT alphabet-name-1, which is why the two user-defined-word alternatives carry DISTINCT kind tags: sharing one tag would have made this rule reject `IF <numeric item> IS <alphabet-name>`, which the standard admits and the 85 golden's F line pins.
